concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-custom-payouts]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Platforms custom-payout overview for scheduled/on-demand user-bank transfers, capability/role and route constraints, cutoffs and TEST scenarios; request or booking is not bank receipt.
warnings: This is a Platforms Transfers API custom-payout route, distinct from legacy Payout API and optional Business Accounts third-party transfers.
The source does not establish approval, cancellation, retry, or irreversible-booking behavior; follow the child operation guides and current contract.
Cross-border CZK prose conflicts with EUR/GBP/USD table; SEPA cutoff example and table differ; TEST table includes cashout absent from the priority list.
